items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 89.5% year on year to Rs 1,402 crore, led by the CP PLUS brand.
items.quote: I am pleased to share that the Q1 FY2027 revenue stood at INR1,402 crores, which is up 89.5% year-on-year, driven by strong traction by CP PLUS brand in the overall AIL revenue.

items.statement: EBITDA was Rs 208 crore and EBITDA margin improved 604 bps to 14.8% on better product and brand mix.
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR208 crores, up 20% year-on-year, with margins improving by 604 basis points to 14.8%, supported by a favorable product and brand mix

items.statement: Lower inventory and debtor days cut the cash conversion cycle to 64 days.
items.quote: Our working capital metrics also showed meaningful progress, with reduction in inventory and debtor days resulting in the improvement of cash conversion cycle to 64 days.

items.statement: Margins eased slightly from Q4 as lower-cost inventory ran out.
items.quote: Margins moderated slightly from Q4 due to the exhaustion of lower-cost inventory.

items.statement: Management says FY27 started strongly and it is confident in its growth for the year.
items.quote: I am pleased to share that we have commenced FY2027 on a strong note and remain confident in our growth trajectory for the year ahead.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance is 14% to 15%; Q1 came in at 14.8%.
items.quote: So Naushad, I think we have given our guidance for the year, which is 14% to 15% EBITDA. We in quarter one stand by that only, I think we are at 14.8%.

items.statement: Management had guided for about a 25% price increase over the full year.
items.quote: For the whole year, we had almost guided that there might be around 25% price increase, so we keep monitoring it quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Price hikes have not yet hurt consumption in a major way.
items.quote: So far we have not seen any consumption effect in a major way and we hope that we are able to mitigate the inflationary pressures in the coming future.

items.statement: Price hikes so far have ranged from 10% to 20% depending on the product.
items.quote: So, product to product it varies. It has varied from between 10% to 20% so far.

items.statement: By the end of H1 the company expects to have raised prices by about 15% to 20% on average.
items.quote: on an average I think by the end of this H1 we would have taken almost a 15% to 20% price increase

items.statement: DDR memory and SoC chip costs have risen sharply across all product categories.
items.quote: the cost hike in DDR and SOC has been phenomenal across all product categories and not only CCTV.

items.statement: Supply-side price rises are passed through, but with a time lag because hikes are gradual.
items.quote: the price rise that's happened on the supply side, it's a pass through but there might be a time delay as because we are gradually passing it to the market.

items.statement: Backward integration should add some basis points of margin as localisation scales up.
items.quote: yes there will be couple of basis points in the coming future as we scale up each aspect of the localization.

items.statement: The company plans to roughly double manufacturing capacity over the next three years.
items.quote: So, we have broadly spoken about almost doubling this capacity in the next three years.

items.statement: Current capacity is about 2.5 million units a month, running at 85% to 90% utilisation.
items.quote: So, Shubham, our current capacity is at about 2.5 million units per month and currently our capacity utilization should be at between 85% to 90%.

items.statement: The housing and enclosure expansion should be operational by Q3 of this financial year.
items.quote: Our housing and enclosure expansion is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational by Q3 of this financial year.

items.statement: By end-August the company will have 42 FA lines, 4 MI lines and 12 SMT lines.
items.quote: This month we are adding three more FA lines and one MI line and with this addition, we have a total of 42 FA lines, 4 MI and 12 SMT lines by the end of August.

items.statement: Debt to equity fell sharply to 0.07.
items.quote: At the same time, our balance sheet remains robust, with debt to equity reducing sharply to just 0.07 level.

items.statement: The company is exploring machine vision cameras, drone camera modules, industrial robots and home IoT products.
items.quote: We are actively exploring to expand into new categories, including machine vision cameras, drone camera modules, industrial autonomous mobile robots and home IoT products such as video door phones, door locks, and smart doorbells.

items.statement: The CP PLUS Pro series adds high-end AI solutions, global shutter cameras and explosion-proof products.
items.quote: We are also broadening our professional portfolio through CP PLUS Pro series of high-end AI powered solutions, global shutter cameras and explosion proof products.

items.statement: The cable JV's Rajasthan facility of about 1 lakh sq ft should start commercial production by year end.
items.quote: The proposed facility in Rajasthan will cover approximately 1 lakh square feet and is expected to start commercial production by end of this financial year.

items.statement: The company held a 43.3% share of India's video surveillance market in FY26 per Frost & Sullivan.
items.quote: Our market share stood at 43.3% in the Indian video surveillance industry in FY2026, as per the Frost & Sullivan report.

items.statement: CCTV is a government priority sector and no policy change is expected.
items.quote: CCTV is a priority sector for the government and we do not see any deviation from policy from the government's side at the moment.

items.statement: Large players that can secure semiconductors are better placed than smaller rivals facing supply and cost challenges.
items.quote: The supply chain side and the cost escalation side there are challenges which I think a large organization with the ability to secure semiconductors like us is in a better position to mitigate

items.statement: Component supply constraints and price hikes are expected to continue for some time.
items.quote: The supply side constraints still continue, the price hikes are still going on from the commentary that we are hearing from the global sources, it's expected to continue for some more time.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: To conclude, Q1 FY2027 represents a strong start to the year. We have delivered exceptional growth, expanded profitability, strengthened our balance sheet

items.statement: Q2 revenue grew 24.5% over Q1 and EBITDA margin rose from 14.8% to 17.6%.
items.quote: Also sequentially, Q2 revenue grew 24.5% over Q1, and EBITDA margin rose from 14.8% to 17.6%.

items.statement: Q2 revenue rose 89.9% year on year to ₹1,746 crore and EBITDA rose 177% to ₹307 crore.
items.quote: In Q2, revenue was ₹1,746 crore, up 89.9% year on year. EBITDA was ₹307 crore, up 177%, with a margin of 17.6%.

items.statement: Collections improved, with receivable days falling to 87 in Q2 from 93 in Q1 and 105 a year ago.
items.quote: Collections have improved. Receivable days came down to 87 in Q2 from 93 in Q1 and 105 a year ago.

items.statement: Q2 gross margin slipped to 30% from 30.8% in Q1 as the company absorbed part of higher SoC and memory costs.
items.quote: In Q2, gross margin was 30%, flat year on year and slightly below Q1 30.8%, as we began absorbing part of the input cost increase in SoC and memory.

items.statement: Reported Q2 PAT was cut by a ₹34.4 crore one-time exceptional item from a fire at the Kadapa plant.
items.quote: Reported PAT for Q2 was ₹185.5 crore after a one-time exceptional item of ₹34.4 crore from a fire incident that happened in our Kadapa plant due to short circuit in September.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance was raised to ₹6,500-6,800 crore from ₹6,000-6,500 crore, implying 54-61% growth.
items.quote: Revenue, we are raising it to ₹6,500— ₹6,500 to ₹6,800 crore, up from ₹6,000 to ₹6,500 crore. Which is a growth of 54 to 61% over the year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance was kept at 14-15%, while PAT margin guidance was raised to 9-10% from 8.5-9.5%.
items.quote: EBITDA margins, we are maintaining still at 14 to 15%. While the PAT margin we are now raising now to 9 to 10%, which earlier was 8.5 to 9.5%.

items.statement: The company expects its FY27 market share to be 43-45%.
items.quote: On our revised guidance, our FY27 share is expected to be in the range of 43 to 45%.

items.statement: Growth is expected to normalize from first-half levels but remain strong.
items.quote: So growth will normalize from these levels while still remaining strong. As you can see in our revised guidance.

items.statement: Management expects the market to grow at an 18-20% unit CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
items.quote: So from a unit growth perspective, we still see that from a 3 to 5 year horizon, there should be a CAGR of 18 to 20% on unit terms.

items.statement: Second-half margins are expected to be lower than Q2 as low-cost inventory is used up and price increases are moderated.
items.quote: As the lower cost inventories gets used up and as we moderate price increases to further gain market share, we expect second half margins to be lower than Q2.

items.statement: First-half gross margin was 30.4%, up 374 basis points year on year.
items.quote: On the margin side, our gross margin for the first half was 30.4%, up 374 basis points year on year.

items.statement: Prices of SoC, DDR and flash components have risen sharply across the electronics industry.
items.quote: Critical semiconductor components like SoC, DDR, and flash prices have risen sharply across the electronics industry.

items.statement: The company passed on input cost increases to the market gradually rather than all at once.
items.quote: We strategically passed on the input cost increases rather than— rather gradually to market instead of all at once.

items.statement: The company plans to spend about ₹650 crore to double capacity by late FY29 to early FY30.
items.quote: the broader goal is to double the capacities by about late FY29 to early FY30, and this will entail a total of about ₹650 crores.

items.statement: Kadapa plant capacity is 2.5 million units a month, which the company plans to more than double through Kadapa Phase 3.
items.quote: On the manufacturing side, our Kadappa plant capacity is at 2.5 million units a month, and we plan to more than double this through Kadappa Phase 3.

items.statement: The cable plant will go live in Q4 of this financial year.
items.quote: The cable plant will also go live in Q4 of this financial year, which is next quarter.

items.statement: A fully integrated lens plant with 2 million lenses per month capacity is planned in Greater Noida.
items.quote: Our fully integrated lens plant is planned in Greater Noida with a capacity of 2 million lenses per month.

items.statement: The company repaid all borrowings in October and is now debt-free.
items.quote: In October, we repaid all our borrowings and now the company is debt-free.

items.statement: At 30 September, cash and equivalents were ₹1,434 crore against borrowings of ₹363 crore.
items.quote: On 30th September, cash and cash equivalents were ₹1,434 crore against borrowing of ₹363 crore.

items.statement: The company agreed to invest ₹45.4 crore for a 30% stake in Blue K Graph AI Solutions.
items.quote: Our board approved and we signed agreements to invest ₹45.4 crore for a 30% stake on a fully diluted basis in Blue K Graph AI Solutions.

items.statement: The new Pro series for the premium enterprise segment is planned to roll out in Q4 FY27.
items.quote: The new range of TP Plus Pro series targets the premium enterprise segment. And its rollout is planned in the coming quarter, in the Q4 of FY27.

items.statement: The Nexiview brand, launched around April, has seen good initial pickup.
items.quote: Nexiview is the brand which has got introduced in about April, and the initial pickup has been good, and we are seeing significant movement.

items.statement: The industry's shift to higher data security standards and trusted supply chains has favored the company.
items.quote: The industry's move to higher data security standards as well as trusted supply chains played to our strengths.

items.statement: More than 40 brands are now STQC certified, according to the online portal.
items.quote: Nikhil, I think as per the online portal, there are almost 40+ brands now which are STQC certified.

items.statement: Management described the input cost situation as very volatile while it continues to stock up on SoCs and memory.
items.quote: it's still a very volatile situation while we are going ahead with the strategy of stocking up on SoCs and memories.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Let me start with the headline. This has been the strongest half in our history.
